items.source: RuntimeHintsRegistrar implementations allow you to get a callback to the RuntimeHints instance managed by the AOT engine. Implementations of this interface can be registered using @ImportRuntimeHints on any Spring bean or @Bean factory method. RuntimeHintsRegistrar implementations are detected and invoked at build time.
items.translation: RuntimeHintsRegistrar实现允许您获取由 AOT 引擎管理的 RuntimeHints 实例的回调。此接口的实现可以通过在任意 Spring Bean 或 @Bean 工厂方法上使用@ImportRuntimeHints进行注册。RuntimeHintsRegistrar实现会在构建时被发现并调用。

items.source: If a bean implements the BeanFactoryInitializationAotProcessor interface, the bean and all of its dependencies will be initialized during AOT processing. We generally recommend that this interface is only implemented by infrastructure beans, such as a BeanFactoryPostProcessor, which have limited dependencies and are already initialized early in the bean factory lifecycle. If such a bean is registered using an @Bean factory method, ensure the method is static so that its enclosing @Configuration class does not have to be initialized.
items.translation: 如果某个 Bean 实现了BeanFactoryInitializationAotProcessor接口，则该 Bean 及其所有依赖项将在 AOT 处理期间进行初始化。 我们通常建议仅由基础设施 Bean（例如BeanFactoryPostProcessor）实现此接口，这些 Bean 的依赖项有限，并且已在 Bean 工厂生命周期早期完成初始化。 如果通过@Bean工厂方法注册此类 Bean，请确保该方法为static，以便无需初始化其外围的@Configuration类。

items.source: If a bean implements the BeanRegistrationAotProcessor interface, the bean and all of its dependencies will be initialized during AOT processing. We generally recommend that this interface is only implemented by infrastructure beans, such as a BeanFactoryPostProcessor, which have limited dependencies and are already initialized early in the bean factory lifecycle. If such a bean is registered using an @Bean factory method, ensure the method is static so that its enclosing @Configuration class does not have to be initialized.
items.translation: 如果某个 Bean 实现了BeanRegistrationAotProcessor接口，则该 Bean 及其所有依赖项将在 AOT 处理期间进行初始化。 我们通常建议仅由基础设施 Bean（例如BeanFactoryPostProcessor）实现此接口，这些 Bean 的依赖项有限，并且已在 Bean 工厂生命周期早期完成初始化。 如果此类 Bean 是使用@Bean工厂方法注册的，请确保该方法为static，以便无需初始化其外围的@Configuration类。

items.source: In this mode, BeanFactoryPostProcessor implementations are invoked as usual. This includes configuration class parsing, import selectors, classpath scanning, etc. Such steps make sure that the BeanRegistry contains the relevant bean definitions for the application. If bean definitions are guarded by conditions (such as @Profile), these are evaluated, and bean definitions that don’t match their conditions are discarded at this stage.

items.source: If custom code needs to register extra beans programmatically, make sure that custom registration code uses BeanDefinitionRegistry instead of BeanFactory as only bean definitions are taken into account. A good pattern is to implement ImportBeanDefinitionRegistrar and register it via an @Import on one of your configuration classes.
items.translation: 如果自定义代码需要以编程方式注册额外的 Bean，请确保自定义注册代码使用 BeanDefinitionRegistry 而不是 BeanFactory，因为只有 Bean 定义才会被考虑。一个良好的模式是实现 ImportBeanDefinitionRegistrar，并通过配置类之一的 @Import 进行注册。

This invokes your custom code as part of configuration class parsing.
items.translation: 这通常可以通过一个BeanDefinitionRegistryPostProcessor来完成。请注意，如果它本身被注册为一个 bean，除非您确保同时实现了BeanFactoryInitializationAotProcessor，否则它在运行时将被再次调用。一种更惯用的方式是实现ImportBeanDefinitionRegistrar，并使用@Import将其注册到您的某个配置类上。这会将您的自定义代码作为配置类解析的一部分进行调用。

items.source: FactoryBean should be used with care as it introduces an intermediate layer in terms of bean type resolution that may not be conceptually necessary. As a rule of thumb, if a FactoryBean instance does not hold long-term state and is not needed at a later point at runtime, it should be replaced by a regular @Bean factory method, possibly with a FactoryBean adapter layer on top (for declarative configuration purposes).
items.translation: FactoryBean 应谨慎使用，因为它在 Bean 类型解析方面引入了一个可能并非概念上必要的中间层。作为一般准则，如果 FactoryBean 实例不持有长期状态，且在运行时后续不需要，则应将其替换为常规的 @Bean 工厂方法，必要时可在其上方添加一层 FactoryBean 适配器（用于声明式配置）。

items.source: @Reflective provides an idiomatic way to flag the need for reflection on an annotated element. For instance, @EventListener is meta-annotated with @Reflective since the underlying implementation invokes the annotated method using reflection.
items.translation: @Reflective 提供了一种惯用的方式来标记需要反射的注解元素。例如，@EventListener 被元注解为 @Reflective，因为其底层实现使用反射调用已注解的方法。

items.source: @RegisterReflection can be used as a meta-annotation to support more specific needs. @RegisterReflectionForBinding is a composed annotation that is meta-annotated with @RegisterReflection and registers the need for serializing arbitrary types. A typical use case is the use of DTOs that the container cannot infer, such as using a web client within a method body.
items.translation: @RegisterReflection 可用作元注解以支持更具体的需求。 @RegisterReflectionForBinding 是一个组合注解，它使用 @RegisterReflection 进行元注解，并注册对任意类型序列化的需求。 一个典型的使用场景是使用容器无法推断的 DTO，例如在方法体内使用 Web 客户端。

items.translation: TimestampConversionRuntimeHints 可以通过@ImportRuntimeHints进行声明式注册，或通过 META-INF/spring/aot.factories 配置文件进行静态注册。

items.source: MergedBeanDefinitionPostProcessor implementations post-process bean definitions to extract additional settings, such as init and destroy methods.
items.translation: MergedBeanDefinitionPostProcessor 实现会后处理 Bean 定义，以提取额外的设置，例如 init 和 destroy 方法。

items.translation: 核心BeanFactoryInitializationAotProcessor实现负责收集每个候选BeanDefinition的必要贡献。它使用专用的BeanRegistrationAotProcessor来完成此操作。

items.source: As a last resort, you can implement your own org.springframework.aot.generate.ValueCodeGenerator$Delegate. To use it, register its fully-qualified name in META-INF/spring/aot.factories using org.springframework.aot.generate.ValueCodeGenerator$Delegate as the key.
items.translation: 作为最后的手段，您可以实现自己的org.springframework.aot.generate.ValueCodeGenerator$Delegate。要使用它，请在META-INF/spring/aot.factories中注册其完全限定名，并使用org.springframework.aot.generate.ValueCodeGenerator$Delegate作为键。

items.source: Specifically, if there is no explicit Converter registered with the ConversionService for a particular source → target type pair, the internal ObjectToObjectConverter will attempt to use conventions to convert a source object to a target type by delegating to a method on the source object or to a static factory method or constructor on the target type. Since this convention-based algorithm can be applied to arbitrary types at runtime, the core container is not able to infer the runtime hints necessary to support such reflection.
items.translation: 具体来说，如果未针对特定的源类型 → 目标类型对向ConversionService显式注册Converter，则内部ObjectToObjectConverter将尝试使用约定将源对象转换为目标类型，方法是委托到源对象上的方法、目标类型上的静态工厂方法或构造函数。由于这种基于约定的算法可在运行时应用于任意类型，核心容器无法推断出支持此类反射所需的运行时提示。

items.source: Spring’s support for AOT optimizations is meant to inspect an ApplicationContext at build time and apply decisions and discovery logic that usually happens at runtime. Doing so allows building an application startup arrangement that is more straightforward and focused on a fixed set of features based mainly on the classpath and the Environment.
items.translation: Spring 对 AOT 优化的支持旨在在构建时检查 ApplicationContext，并应用通常在运行时执行的决策和发现逻辑。这样做可以构建一个更直接的应用程序启动方案，该方案主要基于类路径和 Environment，专注于固定的一组功能。

items.source: Environment properties that impact the presence of a bean (@Conditional) are only considered at build time.
items.translation: Environment 属性仅在构建时影响 Bean 的存在性（@Conditional）。

items.source: Beans registered as singletons (using registerSingleton, typically from ConfigurableListableBeanFactory) cannot be transformed ahead of time either.

items.source: For more targeted discovery and testing, Spring Framework ships a dedicated module with core AOT testing utilities, "org.springframework:spring-core-test". This module contains the RuntimeHints Agent, a Java agent that records all method invocations that are related to runtime hints and helps you to assert that a given RuntimeHints instance covers all recorded invocations. items.source: Once this part completes, the BeanFactory contains the bean definitions that are necessary for the application to run. It does not trigger bean instantiation but allows the AOT engine to inspect the beans that will be created at runtime.
items.translation: 一旦此部分完成，BeanFactory 就包含了应用程序运行所需的 bean 定义。它不会触发 bean 的实例化，但允许 AOT 引擎检查将在运行时创建的 bean。

items.source: An AOT contribution is a component that contributes generated code which reproduces a particular behavior. It can also contribute RuntimeHints to indicate the need for reflection, resource loading, serialization, or JDK proxies.
items.translation: AOT 贡献是一种提供生成代码的组件，这些代码可重现特定行为。它还可以贡献RuntimeHints以指示对反射、资源加载、序列化或 JDK 代理的需求。

items.source: The BeanFactoryInitializationAotProcessor interface can also be implemented directly by a bean. In this mode, the bean provides an AOT contribution equivalent to the feature it provides with a regular runtime. Consequently, such a bean is automatically excluded from the AOT-optimized context.
items.translation: BeanFactoryInitializationAotProcessor 接口也可以由 Bean 直接实现。在这种模式下，该 Bean 提供的 AOT 贡献与其在常规运行时中提供的功能相当。因此，此类 Bean 会自动从 AOT 优化上下文中排除。

items.source: Implemented by a type registered in META-INF/spring/aot.factories with a key equal to the fully-qualified name of the interface. Typically used when the bean definition needs to be tuned for specific features of the core framework.
items.translation: 由在META-INF/spring/aot.factories中注册的类型实现，其键等于接口的完全限定名。通常在需要针对核心框架的特定功能调整 Bean 定义时使用。

items.source: If no BeanRegistrationAotProcessor handles a particular registered bean, a default implementation processes it. This is the default behavior, since tuning the generated code for a bean definition should be restricted to corner cases.

items.source: The container is able to choose the most appropriate constructor to use based on several candidates. However, relying on that is not a best practice, and flagging the preferred constructor with @Autowired if necessary is preferred.

items.source: With RuntimeHintsPredicates, we can check for reflection, resource, serialization, or proxy generation hints. This approach works well for unit tests but implies that the runtime behavior of a component is well known.

items.source: You can learn more about the global runtime behavior of an application by running its test suite (or the app itself) with the GraalVM tracing agent. This agent will record all relevant calls requiring GraalVM hints at runtime and write them out as JSON configuration files.

likely not going to be handled by the AOT engine, and therefore no hints are going to be

Running an application as a native image requires additional information compared to a regular JVM runtime.
For instance, GraalVM needs to know ahead of time if a component uses reflection.
Similarly, classpath resources are not included in a native image unless specified explicitly.
